description:
## Symptom

When compaction completes, no boundary marker is shown in the conversation. (Worse: see Cause — the transcript is being destructively replaced.)

## Cause

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex:1098-1102`:

```elixir
def handle_event(state, {:octo_pi_agent_event, %Event.CompactionEnd{result: {:ok, data}}}) do
  theme = state.theme || Theme.load_builtin(:dark, Theme.detect_color_mode())
  coder_msg = CoderCSM.new(data.summary, Map.get(data, :tokens_before, 0), DateTime.to_iso8601(DateTime.utc_now()))
  csm = TUICSM.new(coder_msg, theme)
  %{state | transcript: [csm]}
end
```

This replaces the **entire** transcript with a single CSM, wiping prior conversation history visually.

## Upstream behavior

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:2841-2848` calls `rebuildChatFromMessages()` (rebuilds transcript from the post-compaction message list), then `addMessageToChat(csm)` to append the CompactionSummaryMessage as a boundary marker.

The CSM TUI component is at `packages/tui/src/components/compaction-summary-message.ts` and renders a `[compaction]` label with summary stats.

## Proposed fix (two options — confirm with user before coding)

**Minimal (visual fix only):**

```elixir
%{state | transcript: state.transcript ++ [csm]}
```
Preserves visual history; appends marker. Doesn't reflect post-compaction message list semantics on next turn.

**Faithful (port upstream rebuild):** Rebuild the transcript from the post-compaction `Coder.Session.Messages` snapshot, then append the CSM. Matches upstream end-to-end.

The faithful version is the right port; the minimal version is at minimum required to stop the destructive replacement.

## Acceptance

- After `/compact` completes, prior turns remain visible.
- A `[compaction]` boundary marker appears at the cut point.
- Validated in tmux.
title: CompactionEnd handler wipes the entire transcript instead of appending a summary marker
